title: The shape and text settings reach everything you picked
goal: The same gap one section further down. Pick three labels and the text settings vanish, so making them all 14 point is three trips; pick two arrows and the shape settings vanish. Both sections should speak for the whole selection the way the colors do, and say where the picked layers disagree.
notes: Follows the Effects and Shadow task and should reuse whatever mixed-value plumbing that one lands. Same cause: LayersPanel.swift availableSections inserts .annotation and .text only inside `if let layer = selectedLayer`. TextInspector (line 1828) and AnnotationInspector (line 1638) both take one Layer. Note the text restyle path already re-measures the frame (EditorState.restyleSelectedText), so doing it for several layers means several re-measures inside one History.perform. AnnotationContent settings differ per shape, so the section should offer the intersection of what the picked shapes have rather than everything.
acceptance: With several text layers picked, the text settings are in the panel and a font, size or weight set there reaches all of them in one undo step
With several shapes picked, their settings are in the panel and thickness or corner settings reach all of them in one undo step
A setting the picked layers disagree on reads as mixed, and setting it makes them agree
A selection holding a mix of kinds shows only the settings the picked layers actually share
Try it: type three labels, band-select them, and set the size once
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task

log.note: deps set to the Effects and Shadow task by the manager pass

Adversarial review BEFORE building. (1) An arrow's Caption is CONTENT, not looks: one field over three arrows could only give all three the same words, which nobody wants. Cut from the multi-selection: the field is offered for one arrow only, while Label size (which IS looks) reaches all of them. (2) The rows a shape offers differ per shape, so a selection offers the INTERSECTION: an arrow and a rectangle together get the thickness they share and nothing else, rather than a Corner Radius slider that does nothing to the arrow. (3) A highlight has nothing but a color, so it sits the section out rather than emptying it for the box beside it - the same rule the shadow rows follow for an unshadowed layer. (4) A section headed Annotation was already fixed to be headed after the shape; over several it needed a plural (Rectangles) and a word for a mixture (Shapes). (5) The mixed treatment for a MENU had to be decided: a blank box says nothing, so Mixed is a real entry in the menu, and choosing anything makes them agree.

Built: PhotonzCore/ContentSelection.swift (TextLayerSelection, ShapeSelection, ShapeSettingRow, AnnotationContent.settingRows, AnnotationShape.pluralTitle, PhotonzDocument.textSelection/shapeSelection) with 25 tests written first. EditorState gained setTextStyle(ids:), setTextAlignment(ids:), previewAnnotationRestyle(ids:)/commitAnnotationRestyle(ids:), previewCaptionFontSize(ids:)/commitCaptionFontSize(ids:) and resetCaptionPlacement(ids:) - each ONE undo step over the whole selection - plus textSelection/shapeSelection readings. TextInspector and AnnotationInspector rewritten to speak for the selection; LayersPanel availableSections now offers .text and .annotation whenever the picked layers have anything to answer for, instead of only inside `if let layer = selectedLayer`.

Two fixes found while building. (a) Restyling text always re-measured inside the box's OLD width, so making a label bold wrapped it onto a second line the moment bold made it a few points wider. A box still hugging its words now re-hugs them at the new type; a box someone stretched keeps the room it was given. Gated on placementEnabled, so Current keeps its old rule untouched. (b) Picking a size the layers already wear recorded an empty undo step, which meant the next Command Z undid the wrong thing. setTextStyle now only touches the labels it actually changes.

Adversarial review AFTER building, on the real app (probe build, Screen Recording granted, real window captures). The three type menus carry no labels on screen, so a Size menu reading Mixed is a bare word in a row of three: added hover text saying which is which, and filed the visible fix as the-type-menus-say-what-they-are-not-just-what-t. Everything else held up.

Verified in the app with Scripts/playtest/selection-type-and-shape-walk.json (15 stages, real window captures). Three labels: Size reads mixed, one pick makes all three 14pt, ONE undo puts back 14/40/40, one weight pick bolds all three and each re-hugs its own words (80->87, 135->146, 93->101 wide, heights unchanged at 52). Two rectangles: section headed Rectangles, Thickness mixed, one pull rounds both to 18pt and ONE undo takes both back to 0. An arrow with a box: headed Shapes, offers thickness only. A label with a box: both sections present, each reading 'Applies to 1 of the 2 selected layers'. 2435 tests green.

Note for a future run: the probe remembers each tool's last style, so a walk whose premise is 'these differ' must SET both states itself rather than trusting what a new object starts at. This walk does that with setTextSizeLarge/setTextWeightRegular and dragThicknessThin/dragShapeCornersSquare. A first run without them read 14pt everywhere where it should have read mixed, and nothing was wrong with the app.
